articles.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
articles.description: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

articles.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
articles.description: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

articles.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
articles.description: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

articles.title: Pixel Tag, Google’s $30 Android-ready answer to Apple’s AirTag, is now available
articles.description: Google's Pixel Tag lets you track lost items with your Android device, similar to Apple's AirTag.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
articles.description: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
articles.description: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

articles.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
articles.description: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

articles.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
articles.description: Trading volume on Polymarket’s US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.

articles.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
articles.description: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
articles.description: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Sundrop turns your endless baby photos into recaps, time lapses, and more — without AI
articles.description: Sundrop is a new iPhone app that uses Apple's on-device AI to help parents rediscover their favorite photos and create keepsakes without uploading images to the cloud.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
articles.description: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

articles.title: Apple TV makes sign language interpretation a built-in accessibility feature
articles.description: Apple TV's new accessibility feature lets viewers turn on sign language interpretation within supported titles.

articles.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
articles.description: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

articles.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
articles.description: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

articles.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
articles.description: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

articles.title: Reddit is turning user conversations into AI-powered product reviews
articles.description: Reddit's new AI-powered reviews summarize what users like and dislike about 10,000 products, helping shoppers research purchases ahead of the holidays.

articles.title: New WhatsApp head wants to make the app easier to use, give its AI more chops
articles.description: Kunal Shah said the company wants to make voice notes, groups, stickers, and video "simpler and more expressive."

articles.description: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.
